newsitem.title: UK: Pace Micro's finance director to step down.
newsitem.headline: Pace Micro's finance director to step down.

text.p: Britain's Pace Micro Technology Plc said on Friday it is seeking a new finance director to replace Steve Jones who is stepping down to devote more time to interests outside the company.
The satellite and cable television equipment company said in a statement that Jones will remain as finance director until a new appointment is made later in the year.
Earlier this week, the company issued a statement saying it knew of no reason for the recent decline in its share price. At 1435 GMT, the share was up one penny at 62-1/2 pence.

Chief executive David Hood has previously been reported as saying he would step down when a replacement was found. Hood became sole chief executive in February following the departure of Barry Rubery, then co-chief executive, who left because of "irreconcilable differences of management style".
